question: Does the PPV recomputed from the source's sensitivity and specificity at the target's prevalence predict the PPV observed at the target?
threshold: one per pair, fitted on the source so that 90% of its ill patients are flagged (the conformal quantile of the positive class)
gap: recomputed minus observed, in proportions (0.01 is one percentage point)
gap_interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 2,000 multinomial redraws of both tables
summarised_when: at least 20 flagged and 10 ill target patients
